classification.genre: Historical conversation containing user-supplied functional specification, assistant proposals and explicit user corrections; not an empirical UX study or implementation evidence.
classification.authority: Preserve user specifications and final corrections as historical decisions; source update/import timestamp is not approval chronology. Current explicit romantic-classifieds scope and adopted beta contract control current work.
classification.functional_specification: Unique profile, original manual content, editorial-free moderation, separate verification dimensions, stable public version and pending revision; promotional credits/referrals/statistics described as future PRD planning, explicitly not automatic extension of minimum technical contract.
classification.scope_conflict: Historical objection to conventional-dating-only scope retained as conflict with later explicit current romantic-only product direction; do not silently restore professional or sexual-service categories.
classification.unsupported_claims: Assistant assertions of 35/40percent abandonment, form field limits, legal safety and guaranteed SEO/SafeSearch are not verified research or local results. User corrections explicitly reject guarantees and hidden device fingerprinting.
classification.original_source_mutation: Conversation reports historical deletion of a predecessor source after user confirmation; not independently verified and not authorization for current deletion.
classification.pending: Visitor conversation captured127k remains unreviewed in full; WCAG partial; broader295-source inventory not exhaustively audited. No B00 closure.

classification.genre: Historical conversation with user draft, assistant assertions, successive explicit user corrections, PRD-VUX02/03/04 candidates and conceptual structural closure. Not an empirical usability study.
classification.provenance: Opening describes inaccessible primary sources replaced by model summaries. No source text proof of exact primary reproduction; original authorship and percent claims remain unverified.
classification.scope: Final user approves documentary update of candidate structural wireframes and eight WF04 contracts; current technical contract explicitly not extended. Conceptual closure is not visual approval, implementation or test evidence.
classification.design_hypotheses: Horizontal cards, fixed header, automatic filtering, dynamic result count and TOP proportion remain hypotheses/options. No new fixed ratio, compulsory instant refresh or result count.
classification.privacy: Explicit user corrections reject universal deletion guarantees for sessionStorage and private URL assumptions; recovery anchored/approximate and privacy-prioritized. Library version claims in historical chat not independently verified here and do not authorize migration.
classification.recommendations: Simple contextual/related candidates from declared attributes; no default persistent intimate visitor history or image-based physical inference; current B15 scope still needs accepted specification.
classification.contact: WF04 contracts separate contact intent from actual external conversation and disallow sending sensitive filters/session tokens to external channel; no internal messaging MVP.
classification.pending: WCAG full text still partial; broad295-source corpus remains unaudited exhaustively. No B00 acceptance.
